citation.title: Haptic Feedback Control Methods for Steering Systems
citation.version: Chalmers Licentiate of Engineering thesis 2019:05, 71 PDF pages, institution-hosted full text
citation.locator: Abstract and steering-control analysis. Torque/impedance and position/admittance are distinct architectures; filtering, steering hardware impedance and arm inertia affect comparisons. Both archived reports cite this thesis.

methods: Six force-feedback steering MATs at nominal 75 km/h: frequency-response and on-center excitation, each with open, position and torque architecture. Bind signals by Name and XIndex 1; the shorter secondary clock holds unrelated Value channels. CLcommTorque comes from SensoWheel desired torque; ActualCLTorque from an actual-values mNm-to-Nm block. MmotREQ is a higher-layer request; actual filtered torsion MtbAct, reference MtbRef and converted TS_torque are distinct named signals. MtbRef has a Saturation block in its logged origin; an unclipped input to that block was not identified. esr2-wheel.csv quantifies pairs without shifting time or correcting signs.

For the three frequency-response tests only, estimate H1 magnitude from CLcommTorque to ActualCLTorque by Welch/CSD on the recorded clock: 1,024 samples, Hann, 50% overlap, mean-subtracted segments. Within each band report median magnitude and coherence only for bins with input PSD at least 0.1% of the global maximum and coherence at least 0.5. Retain both band and supported bin counts.

RAR contains four independent zero-speed test-rig rack-disturbance files: fixed/free wheel × EPAS on/off. Read demanded and actual rack positions by full drive-path suffix; subtract each channel mean for left tracking residual because absolute origins may differ. Four vehicle runs at 75 km/h provide nine channels each. Summarize each on its own source timestamps, without forcing CAN resampling. FrntSteerFEstimd1 is an estimated front steering force.
results: 71,615 force-feedback samples at about 200 Hz. Open-loop frequency test median supported H1 magnitude fell from 1.399 at 0.5–2 Hz (8/8 bins) to 0.611 at 10–20 Hz (34/51). Full-run actual-versus-committed torque RMSE ranged from 0.522 to 1.086 Nm. Across four 1 kHz rack tests (358,181 points), left request span stayed at 1.1236 native units; fixed-wheel actual span changed from 1.250 with EPAS off to 0.540 with EPAS on. Right-side demanded position was constant in every run although the right rack moved. Count the four vehicle files separately from these dynamometer/rig samples.
limits: The commanded/actual motor pair is a named drive-feedback channel, not an independently calibrated shaft transducer. Filtered torsion and converted torque-sensor signals have different processing. No proof of PI windup or pre-/post-limit current is available. Recorded spectra describe an excited coupled loop, not an open-plant causal FRF. The physical vehicle and bench are separate campaigns with distinct clocks, drivers/excitation and offsets.
